Name: Simple Item Spawner
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎒 Simple Item Spawner[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#D8B4FE]Mod Requested By: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45][b]Harold45[/b][/url][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Find items quickly, save your favourites and build reusable item sets in a clear Stardew-style catalogue.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]✨ Browse, Choose, Spawn[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• Search loaded item names or IDs; browse [b]19 categories[/b], source filters and four sorts.
• Enjoy native item icons, larger previews, parchment cards, gold buttons and iridium highlights. Readable coloured controller hints and bold page arrows make navigation clearer.
• Choose [b]1, 10, 99 or a full native stack[/b], up to 999. Equipment stays at one; quality selection supports eligible ordinary items.
• Keep up to [b]500 favourites[/b] shared across saves and [b]50 recent item/quality choices[/b] per farmer and save.
• Save up to [b]20 sets of 36 entries[/b]. Rename, reorder, edit quantities/qualities and review before spawning. Sets are shared across saves.
• Full backpack? Unplaced requests stay in an [b]explicit retry queue[/b]. Clearing requests never removes existing backpack items.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54012/54012-1792192815-993799146.png[/img]
[size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Catalogue 1.2 — isolated native render, not live gameplay.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]🎮 Open & Use[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Open the normal [b]backpack tab[/b] and choose the catalogue shortcut. The optional opening key starts [b]unassigned[/b]. Selecting an item shows its details; [b]Spawn item[/b] grants it.

Keyboard, mouse and controller controls are included. On controller: [b]A[/b] activates, [b]X[/b] spawns, [b]Y[/b] toggles a favourite and [b]B[/b] returns. Use shoulders for categories and triggers for pages. Search and set editing use the native text keyboard.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]⚙ Settings[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use the built-in Settings screen or optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Toggle the mod, backpack shortcut, modded items, tooltips, remembered browsing and iridium selection. These switches default to [b]On[/b]. Set a keyboard/controller opening binding if wanted.

Reset keeps favourites, sets and history. The built-in menu also offers confirmed clearing of the current farmer’s recent history. Twelve languages are included.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54012/54012-1792192814-34463817.png[/img]
[size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Default settings in desktop GMCM — isolated native render, not live gameplay.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]📦 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/b][/url]. GMCM is optional. Extract [b]SimpleItemSpawner[/b] into [b]Mods[/b] and launch through SMAPI.

For updates, replace the program files while preserving [b]config.json[/b] and the [b]data[/b] folder. Back up data to retain favourites, sets and recent history. Remove this mod’s folder to uninstall; follow the supplying mod’s instructions before removing any mod that provides spawned items.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🧪 Compatibility & Limits[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]PC single-player.[/b] Multiplayer and split-screen are disabled. CJB Item Spawner is not required or modified.

Loads registered inventory items and their artwork/retextures. Source filters describe item IDs, not texture authorship. Quest, wallet, recipe, pickup-flag, error and mannequin entries are excluded. Items are fresh defaults; there is no world placement, existing-item state editor or undo.

Native inventory and simulated menu/controller checks passed. [b]Copied-save, live full-modpack and physical-controller testing remain pending.[/b] Translations await native-speaker proofreading. Test a copied save first.

Generative AI was used for code, interface work, translations and this page. Native item artwork is loaded from your game.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please post reports and ideas here. For bugs, include the mod version, game/SMAPI versions and platform; what happened versus what you expected; reproduction steps; a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]; and a screenshot/video if useful. For suggestions, explain the change and how it would help.[/color][/size][/center]
